userRole: 你是用 Codex 交付 ImportWorks 的初级数据运营工程师。每轮只推进一个产品目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据；绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、数据结构、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Contract plan
scenes.objective: Read the complete contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers product, migration, processes, UI, and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件；给我分阶段计划、主要风险和每阶段验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain process and authority boundaries.
scenes.advanceGate: API, storage, worker, dispatcher, and UI ownership is clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 先解释 API、文件存储、PostgreSQL、校验与提交 Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 各自负责什么。

scenes.title: Data flows
scenes.objective: Explain successful and rejected import flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Atomic boundaries and forbidden partial states are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释一个成功的 VALID_ROWS 导入和一个必须整批拒绝的 ALL_OR_NOTHING 导入的完整数据流。

scenes.title: Public contracts
scenes.objective: Author OpenAPI, state, error, idempotency, seed, and snapshot contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: All public contracts are machine-checkable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态机、错误、幂等、Seed、Snapshot、Work 和 Event 契约，本轮不要实现业务。

scenes.title: Verification design
scenes.objective: Define each real test layer.
scenes.advanceGate: Each published gate proves distinct invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别如何验证公开不变量。

scenes.title: Runnable skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the production process skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: All roles build, boot, and stop independently.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小可运行的 TypeScript API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并做真实 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement repeatable migration and atomic seed.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay, conflict, unknown member, and bad reference behavior pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，并验证重复执行、完全重放、版本冲突和非法整批回滚。

scenes.title: Resumable upload
scenes.objective: Implement chunk integrity and resume.
scenes.advanceGate: Out-of-order retry and restart resume preserve exact bytes.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 ImportJob、分片上传、乱序重试、缺口查询、整文件完成和重启续传，并用真实字节验证。

scenes.title: Validation
scenes.objective: Implement frozen-schema streaming validation.
scenes.advanceGate: Findings are complete, stable, sorted, and redacted.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成冻结 Schema Revision 的 NDJSON 校验和稳定、脱敏的 findings，并验证边界输入。

scenes.title: Commit modes
scenes.objective: Implement atomic and partial commit.
scenes.advanceGate: Row counts and external identities reconcile.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 ALL_OR_NOTHING 与 VALID_ROWS 提交、外部行身份冲突和可重复 error report。

scenes.title: Idempotency and races
scenes.objective: Prove unknown outcome and multi-process convergence.
scenes.advanceGate: One logical import produces one durable result.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证未知 HTTP 结果、并发 replay、两 API 同时 complete/commit 和进程重启都只产生一个结果。

scenes.title: Worker and outbox
scenes.objective: Implement fenced work and transactional events.
scenes.advanceGate: Controlled kills recover without duplicate effects.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成校验、提交、报告 Work 和事务性 Event，并用 barrier 分别验证 Worker 与 dispatcher 的 SIGKILL 恢复。

scenes.title: Production UI
scenes.objective: Deliver the real import workflow UI.
scenes.advanceGate: A browser can upload, resume, inspect, commit, and report through HTTP.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 驱动的导入、续传、校验结果、提交、错误报告和记录浏览 UI。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Run the complete V1 verification and findings-first review.
scenes.advanceGate: No unresolved V1 correctness finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行真实 Integration、Chromium、双 API/双 Worker、Recovery 和全量非性能测试，做 findings-first V1 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Publish ImportBundle and request impact analysis only.
scenes.advanceGate: Schema, API, worker, UI, migration, race, and tests are covered before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】增加跨文件 ImportBundle 原子发布。一个 Bundle 冻结同一租户多个 VALIDATED ImportJob；VALIDATED 表示校验完成且可以包含 findings，带 findings 的 ALL_OR_NOTHING Job 到 commit 或 Bundle publish 时才 REJECTED。同一 ImportJob 只能属于一个未终结 Bundle。Bundle 状态为 DRAFT -> STAGED -> PUBLISHING -> PUBLISHED | REJECTED | CANCELLED；STAGED 后成员、Schema Revision、源摘要和提交模式不可修改。公开形状为 ImportBundle = {bundleId:uuid,tenantId:uuid,name:string,state:string,createdAt:timestamp,stagedAt:timestamp|null,publishedAt:timestamp|null} 与 BundleMember = {bundleId:uuid,importId:uuid,position:int,schemaRevision:int,sourceSha256:sha256,commitMode:ALL_OR_NOTHING|VALID_ROWS}；FINAL snapshot 使用 importBundles 与 bundleMembers。POST /api/v1/import-bundles 使用 {tenantId:uuid,name:string}；POST /api/v1/import-bundles/:bundleId/members 使用 {importId:uuid}；POST /api/v1/import-bundles/:bundleId/stage 与 POST /api/v1/import-bundles/:bundleId/publish 使用 {}。每个 mutation 都要求 durable Idempotency-Key，成功返回完整 Bundle 或 Member。publish 必须所有允许记录与事件一起成功或全部失败；ALL_OR_NOTHING 成员有错误时整个 Bundle REJECTED。稳定错误为 409 BUNDLE_MEMBER_CONFLICT、409 BUNDLE_FROZEN、409 BUNDLE_NOT_STAGEABLE、409 BUNDLE_NOT_PUBLISHABLE、409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT 和 404 NOT_FOUND，并使用 V1 JSON error envelope。两个 API、重复请求、未知响应与 Worker 重启必须收敛且不得部分发布。Bundle publish 使用公开 Work kind BUNDLE_PUBLISH，aggregateId = bundleId。迁移保留全部 V1 ImportJob、chunk、finding、record、report、Event、Work 和 replay；既有已提交 ImportJob 不得回写。更新 OpenAPI、Worker、production UI 和所有测试。本轮先只做影响分析和分阶段计划。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更对 schema、API、Worker、UI、兼容迁移和测试的影响，不要立即编码。

scenes.title: Compatible migration
scenes.objective: Implement and verify the Bundle migration.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 snapshot and durable replay survive unchanged.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 imports、chunks、findings、records、reports、events、Work 和 replay 完整保留。

scenes.title: Bundle backend
scenes.objective: Implement Bundle lifecycle and atomic publish.
scenes.advanceGate: Lifecycle, freeze, and all-or-nothing publication pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 ImportBundle 的成员、stage、publish、失败回滚和对应 OpenAPI。

scenes.title: Bundle races and recovery
scenes.objective: Verify Bundle contention and process failure.
scenes.advanceGate: Two APIs and killed workers cannot partially publish.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证 Bundle 成员竞争、并发 publish、未知响应、Worker SIGKILL 和 outbox 未知 ACK。

scenes.title: Manager UI and regression
scenes.objective: Complete Bundle UI and full real regression.
scenes.advanceGate: Production browser and all non-performance gates pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Bundle UI 和真实 Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 回归。

scenes.title: Sustained pressure
scenes.objective: Run all published performance scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式持续压力场景，报告真实指标，并重新核对字节、行、事件、租户和 Work 不变量。

scenes.title: Final handoff
scenes.objective: Complete final findings-first review and truthful handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Evidence, risks, and unrun checks are accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有证据的问题，并给出命令结果、风险、未运行项和完整 handoff。
